articles.title: Is Watching Videos at 2x Speed a Bad Idea?
articles.summary: In You Can See Everything , the documentary about Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her husband Billy Evans, Evans is often seen busily watching videos on 2x speed . He’s not the only one; many people, especially younger ones , are playing video and audio content at faster speeds to get through the material more quickly. articles.title: Yesteryear Became a Cultural Sensation. Caro Claire Burke Is Still Reeling
articles.summary: The nurses in the labor and delivery unit at a Boston-area hospital were in for a surprise. On the Wednesday in September when their book club was scheduled to discuss Caro Claire Burke ’s Yesteryear , the author herself showed up to deliver her first child. Which is how, in the heady aftermath of giving birth, Burke found herself propped up in her hospital bed, signing copies of her novel. articles.title: Want to Feel Happier? Spend $5 on Someone Else
articles.summary: If someone handed you $5 and told you to buy whatever would make you happiest, who would you spend it on? If you said “yourself,” well, that’s a pretty tempting answer. Your favorite coffee would surely turn your morning around; a chocolate croissant wouldn’t hurt, either. And research suggests that most people tend to think they’d get the biggest happiness boost by spending money on themselves. Yet treating someone else might leave you feeling even better.
